C-COU-001E.title_en: The Physique and Will of French Youth: Critiquing the 'Walking Dictionary' Education
C-COU-001E.title_zh: 法国青年的体魄与意志：批判'行走的词典'教育
C-COU-001E.description_en: After France's defeat in the Franco-Prussian War, Coubertin witnessed firsthand the weak physique and depressed will of French youth. He critiqued the French education system for overemphasizing intellectual training, producing 'walking dictionaries' — knowledge-rich but physically weak and willfully fragile. He advocated reviving the ancient Greek ideal of kalokagathia (beauty and goodness in unity), arguing that true education must cultivate both bodily strength and spiritual excellence, achieving permanent union of muscles and intellect. This philosophy became the deep motivation behind his later founding of the Olympic Movement.
C-COU-001E.description_zh: 普法战争失败后，顾拜旦亲眼目睹法国青年体魄孱弱、意志消沉的现状。他批判当时法国教育过度侧重智育，将学生培养成'行走的词典'——知识丰富但身体虚弱、缺乏意志力。他主张恢复古希腊kalokagathia（美善合一）的理想，认为真正的教育应当同时培养身体的力量与精神的卓越，让肌肉与智识实现永久统一。这一理念成为他后来创立奥林匹克运动的深层动因。

C-COU-002E.title_en: Art and Sport Side by Side: The Art Competition Tradition at the Stockholm Olympics
C-COU-002E.title_zh: 艺术与体育并列：斯德哥尔摩奥运会的艺术竞赛传统
C-COU-002E.description_en: At the 1912 Stockholm Olympics, art competitions were formally established for the first time, including literature, music, painting, sculpture, and architecture. Coubertin himself won the literature gold medal under the pen name 'George Hohrod' for his 'Ode to Sport.' This practice embodied his mind-body unity philosophy: sport and art should stand equally, jointly cultivating complete personality. Although art competitions were discontinued after 1948, the underlying educational philosophy — achieving comprehensive human development through diverse expression — continues to have profound influence.
C-COU-002E.description_zh: 1912年斯德哥尔摩奥运会首次正式设立艺术竞赛，包括文学、音乐、绘画、雕塑和建筑五个类别。顾拜旦本人以笔名'乔治·霍尔'发表《体育颂》，获得文学类金奖。这一实践体现了他的身心合一理念：体育与艺术应当并重，共同培养完整的人格。艺术竞赛虽在1948年后取消，但其背后的教育理念——通过多元表达实现人的全面发展——仍影响深远。

C-COU-003E.title_en: The London Olympics Marathon: Dorando Pietri's Perseverance and Respect
C-COU-003E.title_zh: 伦敦奥运会的马拉松：多兰多·彼得里的坚持与尊重
C-COU-003E.description_en: At the 1908 London Olympics Marathon, Italian runner Dorando Pietri repeatedly fell from exhaustion before finally crossing the finish line with staff assistance. Though disqualified, the entire audience rose to applaud him, and Queen Alexandra personally presented a trophy with the words: 'The Olympic game is not so much about winning as taking part.' This event became the classic embodiment of the Olympic creed, reflecting Coubertin's core philosophy — the struggle process itself holds greater educational value than the result of victory or defeat.
C-COU-003E.description_zh: 1908年伦敦奥运会马拉松比赛中，意大利选手多兰多·彼得里（Dorando Pietri）在体力透支的情况下多次跌倒，最终在工作人员搀扶下闯入终点。尽管被取消成绩，全场观众起立为他鼓掌，女王亚历山德拉亲自颁发奖杯并致辞：'奥林匹克比赛最重要的不是取胜，而是参与。'这一事件成为奥林匹克信条的经典诠释，也体现了顾拜旦的核心理念——奋斗过程本身比胜负结果更具教育价值。

C-COU-004E.title_en: The First Modern Olympics in Athens: Participation Itself Is Victory
C-COU-004E.title_zh: 雅典首届现代奥运会：参与本身就是胜利
C-COU-004E.description_en: The 1896 Athens First Modern Olympics brought together 241 athletes from 14 countries. Coubertin emphasized at the opening ceremony that the value of the Olympics lies not in setting records or determining winners, but in gathering youth from various nations and showcasing humanity's pursuit of excellence. Many participants later recalled that simply standing on the Olympic stage was the greatest honor. This philosophy influenced countless athletes thereafter — those who may not have won gold medals, but through participation achieved self-transcendence.
C-COU-004E.description_zh: 1896年雅典第一届现代奥运会汇聚了14个国家的241名运动员。顾拜旦在开幕式上强调，奥运会的价值不在于创造纪录或决出胜负，而在于汇聚各国青年、展示人类追求卓越的精神。许多参赛者在赛后回忆中称，能够站在奥运赛场本身就是无上的荣耀。这一理念影响了后世无数运动员——他们或许未能夺冠，但通过参与奥运实现了自我超越。

C-COU-005E.title_en: The Sorbonne Congress: Modern Transformation of Ancient Olympic Ideals
C-COU-005E.title_zh: 索邦大学会议：古代奥运理想的现代转化
C-COU-005E.description_en: In June 1894, Coubertin convened an international sports congress at the Sorbonne University in Paris, where representatives from 12 countries passed a resolution to revive the Olympic Games. Coubertin did not simply replicate ancient Olympic forms, but creatively transformed ancient resources: preserving core elements like competitive spirit, peace philosophy, and periodic hosting, while adapting to modern social needs — establishing the IOC as a standing institution, formulating modern competition rules, and allowing female participation (though initially limited). This 'ancient revival method' became a classic case of creative transformation of cultural heritage.
C-COU-005E.description_zh: 1894年6月，顾拜旦在巴黎索邦大学组织召开国际体育会议，来自12个国家的代表通过了恢复奥运会的决议。顾拜旦没有简单复制古代奥运会的形式，而是创造性地转化古代资源：保留竞技精神、和平理念、周期举办等核心元素，同时适应现代社会需求——设立国际奥委会作为常设机构、制定现代竞赛规则、允许女性参与（尽管初期有限）。这一'古代复兴法'成为文化遗产创造性转化的经典案例。

C-COU-006E.title_en: From Olympia to Athens: Modern Echoes of the Ancient Sacred Truce
C-COU-006E.title_zh: 从奥林匹亚到雅典：古代神圣休战的现代回响
C-COU-006E.description_en: Coubertin extracted the peace concept from the ancient Olympic 'Ekecheiria' (sacred truce) tradition and transformed it into the modern Olympic Truce Resolution. This resolution calls on nations to cease armed conflict during the Olympic period, allowing athletes safe passage. From the 1896 Athens First Modern Olympics to the 21st century Beijing Olympics, this tradition has been continually reaffirmed and strengthened. Coubertin's innovation lies in transforming a peace commitment from ancient religious ritual into a soft diplomatic tool in modern international politics, providing a de-escalation mechanism for tense international relations.
C-COU-006E.description_zh: 顾拜旦从古希腊奥运会的'神圣休战'（Ekecheiria）传统中提取和平理念，将其转化为现代奥林匹克休战决议。这一决议要求各国在奥运期间停止武装冲突，让运动员安全通行。从1896年雅典首届现代奥运会到21世纪的北京奥运会，这一传统不断被重申和强化。顾拜旦的创造性在于：他将古代宗教仪式中的和平承诺，转化为现代国际政治中的软性外交工具，为紧张的国际关系提供了一种缓和机制。

C-COU-007E.title_en: The Controversy of the Berlin Olympics: The Ideal and Reality of Sports Diplomacy
C-COU-007E.title_zh: 柏林奥运会的争议：体育外交的理想与现实
C-COU-007E.description_en: During the 1936 Berlin Olympics, the Nazi regime attempted to use the Games for racial propaganda, but Coubertin's sports diplomacy ideal was still partially realized to some extent. Despite political forces attempting to manipulate sport, athletes from different nations still forged friendships transcending ideology on the competition field. This case reveals the complexity of Coubertin's 'international understanding method': sport can transcend politics, but也难以完全脱离政治. Subsequent events during the Cold War, such as 'Ping Pong Diplomacy' and joint entries by North and South Korea, continued this tension between ideal and reality.
C-COU-007E.description_zh: 1936年柏林奥运会期间，纳粹政权试图利用奥运会进行种族宣传，但顾拜旦的体育外交理想仍在一定程度上得以实现。尽管政治力量试图操纵体育，不同国家的运动员仍在赛场上建立了跨越意识形态的友谊。这一案例揭示了顾拜旦'国际理解法'的复杂性：体育可以超越政治，但也难以完全脱离政治。冷战期间的'乒乓外交'、朝韩联合入场等后续事件，都延续了这一理想与现实的张力。

C-COU-008E.title_en: Ping Pong Diplomacy: How Small Ball Moved the Big Ball
C-COU-008E.title_zh: 乒乓外交：小球转动大球
C-COU-008E.description_en: In 1972, the friendly exchanges between Chinese and American table tennis players became a diplomatic breakthrough that broke the Cold War deadlock. This event perfectly illustrated Coubertin's 'international understanding method': sport transcended political divisions and became a bridge connecting adversarial nations. Chinese athletes invited the American team to visit China, and President Nixon subsequently visited China, initiating the normalization of Sino-US relations. Coubertin once said 'athletes are ambassadors of peace,' and this case proves that sports diplomacy can play a unique role when formal diplomatic channels are blocked.
C-COU-008E.description_zh: 1972年，中美两国乒乓球运动员的友好交流成为打破冷战僵局的外交突破。这一事件完美诠释了顾拜旦的'国际理解法'：体育超越了政治分歧，成为连接敌对国家的桥梁。中国运动员邀请美国队访华，美国总统尼克松随后访问中国，开启了中美关系正常化进程。顾拜旦曾言'运动员是和平大使'，这一案例证明体育外交可以在正式外交渠道受阻时发挥独特作用。

C-COU-009E.title_en: The Persistence and Dilemma of Amateurism: Class Limitations in Early Olympics
C-COU-009E.title_zh: 业余主义的坚守与困境：早期奥运会的阶级局限
C-COU-009E.description_en: Coubertin firmly upheld the amateur principle, believing that only amateur athletes could embody pure competitive spirit. This principle was strictly implemented in early Olympics, effectively excluding the working masses — as they needed to work for survival and could not dedicate sufficient time to training. Coubertin's amateurism carried distinct elitist overtones, reflecting his aristocratic background. It was not until the 1980s that the IOC gradually relaxed restrictions, allowing professional athletes to compete. This historical limitation reminds us: even lofty ideals may carry class biases of their era.
C-COU-009E.description_zh: 顾拜旦坚决坚持业余主义原则，认为只有业余运动员才能体现纯粹的竞技精神。这一原则在早期奥运会中严格实施，实际上将广大劳动者排除在外——因为他们需要工作谋生，无法投入充足时间训练。顾拜旦的业余主义带有明显的精英主义色彩，反映了他出身的贵族背景。直到1980年代，国际奥委会才逐步放宽限制，允许职业运动员参加。这一历史局限提醒我们：即使是崇高的理想，也可能带有时代的阶级偏见。

C-COU-010E.title_en: The Awakening of Professional Players: The End of Amateurism and Continuation of Sporting Spirit
C-COU-010E.title_zh: 职业球员的觉醒：业余主义的终结与体育精神的延续
C-COU-010E.description_en: At the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics, the IOC began gradually relaxing amateur restrictions, allowing some professional athletes to compete. The 1992 'Dream Team' participating in Barcelona Olympics marked the formal entrance of professional athletes onto the Olympic stage. Although Coubertin's amateur principle had class limitations historically, its core spirit — fair competition, respect for rules, pursuit of excellence — continues in the professionalized era. Modern anti-doping policies and fair competition mechanisms are inheritances and developments of Coubertin's sports ethics thought.
C-COU-010E.description_zh: 1984年洛杉矶奥运会，国际奥委会开始逐步放宽业余主义限制，允许部分职业运动员参赛。1992年'梦之队'参加巴塞罗那奥运会，标志着职业运动员正式登上奥运舞台。顾拜旦的业余主义原则虽然在历史上具有阶级局限，但其核心精神——公平竞争、尊重规则、追求卓越——仍在职业化时代得以延续。现代反兴奋剂政策、公平竞赛机制，都是对顾拜旦体育伦理思想的继承与发展。

C-COU-011E.title_en: The Character Classroom of the Antwerp Olympics: The Educational Value of Failure
C-COU-011E.title_zh: 安特卫普奥运会的品格课堂：失败的教育价值
C-COU-011E.description_en: At the 1920 Antwerp Olympics, many young athletes experienced their first international competition failure. Coubertin pointed out in his memoirs that failure is more educational than victory — it teaches young people how to face setbacks and start anew. He particularly emphasized that every fall in sporting competition is an opportunity for character forging: learning to remain calm under pressure, rise after failure, respect opponents, and stay humble in victory. The cultivation of these 'moral muscles' is precisely the core value of sports education.
C-COU-011E.description_zh: 1920年安特卫普奥运会，许多年轻运动员经历了人生首次国际大赛的失败。顾拜旦在回忆录中指出，失败比胜利更具教育意义——它教会年轻人如何面对挫折、如何重新开始。他特别强调，体育竞赛中的每一次跌倒都是品格锻造的机会：学会在压力下保持冷静、在失败后重新站起、尊重对手、在胜利时保持谦逊。这些'道德肌肉'的培养，正是体育教育的核心价值。

C-COU-012E.title_en: Jesse Owens' Victory: Sport as the Ultimate Test of Character
C-COU-012E.title_zh: 杰西·欧文斯的胜利：体育作为品格的终极考验
C-COU-012E.description_en: At the 1936 Berlin Olympics, African-American athlete Jesse Owens, against the backdrop of Nazi propaganda promoting 'Aryan superiority,' bravely won four gold medals. His victory was not merely a sporting achievement, but a triumph of character — in the face of racial discrimination and political oppression, he proved himself through ability and grace. Coubertin's character forging method reached its ultimate expression here: sporting competition became a venue for testing personality, with Owens demonstrating the core values of sportsmanship through elegant conduct and outstanding performance: respect, resilience, transcending prejudice.
C-COU-012E.description_zh: 1936年柏林奥运会，非洲裔美国运动员杰西·欧文斯在纳粹宣扬'雅利安人优越论'的背景下，勇夺四枚金牌。他的胜利不仅是体育成就，更是品格的胜利——在种族歧视和政治压迫面前，他以实力和风度证明了自己。顾拜旦的品格锻造法在此得到极致体现：体育竞技成为检验人格的场所，欧文斯以优雅的风度和卓越的表现，展现了体育精神的核心价值：尊重、坚韧、超越偏见。

C-COU-013E.title_en: The Birth of the Five Rings: Collective Identity Construction Through Symbolic Design
C-COU-013E.title_zh: 五环标志的诞生：象征符号的集体认同建构
C-COU-013E.description_en: In 1913, Coubertin designed the Olympic five-rings logo: five interlocking rings represent the five continents, and six colors (blue, yellow, black, green, red, and white background) encompass all national flag colors. This design quickly became one of the most recognizable sports logos globally. Coubertin deeply understood the power of ritual symbolism — the five rings are not merely a pattern, but the visual embodiment of the Olympic spirit, making abstract concepts visible, tangible, and transmissible. This case demonstrates how collective identity can be constructed through symbolic design.
C-COU-013E.description_zh: 1913年，顾拜旦设计了奥林匹克五环标志：五个相交的圆环代表五大洲，六种颜色（蓝、黄、黑、绿、红及白色背景）涵盖所有国旗的颜色。这一设计迅速成为全球最具辨识度的体育标志之一。顾拜旦深谙仪式象征的力量——五环不仅是一个图案，更是奥林匹克精神的视觉化身，让抽象的理念变得可见、可感、可传承。这一案例展示了如何通过符号设计建构集体认同。

C-COU-014E.title_en: The Creation of the Torch Relay: Intergenerational Transmission Through Ritualized Memory
C-COU-014E.title_zh: 圣火传递的创立：仪式化记忆的世代传承
C-COU-014E.description_en: At the 1928 Amsterdam Olympics, Coubertin proposed and established the Olympic cauldron tradition: collecting flame from the Temple of Hera in Olympia, Greece, and passing it via torch relay to the host city. This ritual connects ancient and modern, allowing the Olympic spirit to continue through tangible flame across time and space. The torch relay became the most ceremonial segment of each Olympics, strengthening participants' sense of belonging and mission. Coubertin's ritual symbolism method reached its peak here: abstract ideals become perceptible and transmissible through recurring rituals.
C-COU-014E.description_zh: 1928年阿姆斯特丹奥运会，顾拜旦提议并确立了奥运圣火传递仪式：从希腊奥林匹亚的赫拉神庙采集圣火，通过火炬接力传递到主办城市。这一仪式将古代与现代连接，让奥林匹克精神通过具象化的 Flame 在时空中延续。圣火传递成为每届奥运会最具仪式感的环节，强化了参与者的归属感和使命感。顾拜旦的仪式象征法在此达到巅峰：抽象的理想通过重复性的仪式变得可感知、可传承。

C-COU-015E.title_en: The Establishment of the IOC: Institutional Guarantee for Ideal Realization
C-COU-015E.title_zh: 国际奥委会的创立：制度保障的理想实现
C-COU-015E.description_en: At the 1894 Sorbonne Congress, Coubertin pushed for the establishment of the International Olympic Committee (IOC). He designed its governance structure: members recommended by countries, serving for life, with non-governmental status. This institutional design ensured the IOC's independence and continuity, insulating it from government changes. Coubertin recognized that ideals without institutional support are mere dreams. The successful operation of the IOC proved the effectiveness of the 'institutional foundation method' — by institutionalizing ideals, the Olympic Movement has been able to endure for over a century.
C-COU-015E.description_zh: 1894年索邦大学会议上，顾拜旦推动成立了国际奥林匹克委员会（IOC）。他设计了其治理结构：委员由各国自行推荐、终身任职、非政府性质。这一制度设计确保了IOC的独立性和持续性，使其不受政府更迭影响。顾拜旦认识到，没有制度保障的理想只能是空想。IOC的成功运作，证明了'机构奠基法'的有效性——通过将理念制度化，奥林匹克运动得以跨越百年持续传承。

C-COU-016E.title_en: Coubertin's Retirement: Institutional Resilience Beyond the Individual
C-COU-016E.title_zh: 顾拜旦的退休：机构超越个人的制度韧性
C-COU-016E.description_en: In 1925, Coubertin resigned as IOC president, succeeded by Henri de Baillet-Latour. Remarkably, the Olympic Movement did not decline following the founder's departure. This fact validated Coubertin's institutional foundation method: the institutional framework he designed possesses resilience beyond the individual. The IOC's governance structure ensures decision-making continuity and adaptability, allowing the Olympic Movement to adjust itself in different eras while continuing to serve the ideals of peace and sport. Coubertin's foresight lay in: he not only created an organization, but also designed mechanisms allowing the organization to function even after he was gone.
C-COU-016E.description_zh: 1925年，顾拜旦辞去IOC主席职务，由亨利·德·巴耶-拉图尔接任。令人瞩目的是，奥林匹克运动并未因创始人的离去而衰落。这一事实验证了顾拜旦的机构奠基法：他设计的制度框架具有超越个人的韧性。IOC的治理结构确保了决策的连续性和适应性，使奥林匹克运动能够在不同时代调整自身，持续服务于和平与体育的理想。顾拜旦的远见在于：他不仅创建了组织，更设计了让组织在没有他之后仍能运转的机制。

C-COU-017E.title_en: The Birth of 'Ode to Sport': The Perfect Fusion of Sport and Literature
C-COU-017E.title_zh: 《体育颂》的诞生：体育与文学的完美融合
C-COU-017E.description_en: At the 1912 Stockholm Olympics, Coubertin published 'Ode to Sport' under the pen name 'George Hohrod,' winning the literature gold medal. This poem praises the sacredness and beauty of sport, elevating sport to the level of art and philosophy. Coubertin's practice demonstrated cultural synthesis: sport and art are not opposed, but complementary. Through artistic expression, the spiritual value of sport is sublimated; through sporting practice, artistic creativity is activated. This integration cultivates complete personality rather than single-dimensional expertise.
C-COU-017E.description_zh: 1912年斯德哥尔摩奥运会，顾拜旦以笔名'乔治·霍尔'发表《体育颂》，获得文学类金奖。这首诗赞美体育的神圣与美好，将体育提升到艺术与哲学的层面。顾拜旦的实践证明了文化融合法：体育与艺术不是对立的，而是互补的。通过艺术表达，体育的精神价值得以升华；通过体育实践，艺术的创造力得以激活。这种融合培养了完整的人格，而非单一维度的专长。

C-COU-018E.title_en: The End of Art Competitions and Its Legacy: Contemporary Insights from Sports Aesthetics
C-COU-018E.title_zh: 艺术竞赛的终结与遗产：体育美学的当代启示
C-COU-018E.description_en: After the 1948 London Olympics, art competitions were formally discontinued. However, Coubertin's cultural integration philosophy did not disappear. Although contemporary Olympics no longer have art awards, opening ceremonies, venue design, and Olympic mascots still reflect the fusion of sport and art. Modern educational concepts also continue this idea: STEAM education incorporates Arts into the STEM system, emphasizing interdisciplinary cultivation. Coubertin's foresight lay in: he recognized as early as the early 20th century that complete education must include aesthetic dimensions, otherwise it cultivates only one-dimensional individuals.
C-COU-018E.description_zh: 1948年伦敦奥运会后，艺术竞赛被正式取消。然而，顾拜旦的文化融合理念并未消失。当代奥运会虽然不再设立艺术奖项，但开幕式、场馆设计、奥运吉祥物等仍体现着体育与艺术的融合。现代教育理念也延续了这一思想：STEAM教育将艺术（Arts）纳入STEM体系，强调跨学科培养。顾拜旦的远见在于：他早在20世纪初就认识到，完整的教育必须包含美学维度，否则培养的只是片面的人。

C-COU-019E.title_en: The Shadow of the Munich Olympics: The Shattering and Rebuilding of Peaceful Competition Ideals
C-COU-019E.title_zh: 慕尼黑奥运会的阴影：和平竞争理想的破灭与重建
C-COU-019E.description_en: During the 1972 Munich Olympics, the Palestinian terrorist group 'Black September' took hostages and murdered 11 Israeli athletes. This tragic event severely impacted the Olympic peace ideal. However, Coubertin's 'peaceful competition method' was not abandoned because of this. Instead, after the Olympics, the international community strengthened anti-terrorism cooperation, and the Olympic Truce Resolution gained wider recognition. This case shows: peaceful competition does not mean avoiding conflict, but transforming confrontation into civilized forms within a rules framework. Even in the darkest moments, the value of rules and respect cannot be abandoned.
C-COU-019E.description_zh: 1972年慕尼黑奥运会期间，巴勒斯坦恐怖组织'黑色九月'劫持并杀害了11名以色列运动员。这一悲剧事件严重冲击了奥林匹克和平理想。然而，顾拜旦的'和平竞争法'并未因此被抛弃。相反，奥运会之后，国际社会加强了反恐合作，奥林匹克休战决议得到更广泛的认可。这一案例表明：和平竞争不等于回避冲突，而是在规则框架内将对抗转化为文明形式。即使在最黑暗的时刻，规则与尊重的价值依然不可放弃。

C-COU-020E.title_en: South Africa's Return to the Olympics: Sport as Peaceful Power for Conflict Transformation
C-COU-020E.title_zh: 南非重返奥运：体育作为冲突转化的和平力量
C-COU-020E.description_en: At the 1992 Barcelona Olympics, South Africa returned to the Olympic stage for the first time after ending the apartheid system. This event carried profound symbolic significance: sport became a tool for resolving racial conflict and promoting national reconciliation. Coubertin's 'peaceful competition method' was perfectly embodied here — a group once excluded from sport, through observing common rules, reintegrated into the international community. Sports competition provides a neutral platform where former enemies can fairly compete under rules, thereby creating conditions for political reconciliation. This case demonstrates the tremendous potential of sport as a conflict transformation mechanism.
C-COU-020E.description_zh: 1992年巴塞罗那奥运会，南非在结束种族隔离制度后首次重返奥运舞台。这一事件具有深刻的象征意义：体育成为化解种族冲突、促进民族和解的工具。顾拜旦的'和平竞争法'在此得到完美体现——曾经被体育排斥的群体，通过遵守共同规则重新融入国际社会。体育竞赛提供了一个中立的平台，让曾经的敌人可以在规则之下公平竞争，从而为政治和解创造条件。这一案例证明了体育作为冲突转化机制的巨大潜力。
